questions.q: In an election between two candidates, $65\%$ of the voters cast their votes, out of which $3\%$ of the votes were decided to be invalid. A candidate got 81965 votes which are $65\%$ of the total valid votes. What is the total number of votes enrolled in that election?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, options aur decimals dekh kar samajh ja ki Digital Sum (DS) lagana hai, lamba calculation avoid karna hai.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): $81965$ ka DS = 2. Denominator me $0.65 \to 2$, $0.97 \to 7$, $0.65 \to 2$. Multiply kar: $2 \times 7 \times 2 = 28 \to 1$. Yani $T \times 1 = 2$, toh $T$ ka DS 2 aana chahiye. Options me sirf 200000 ka DS 2 hai. Boom! Pen uthane ki bhi zaroorat nahi thi.

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Total votes $T$ maan le. Equation banegi: $T \times 0.65 \times 0.97 \times 0.65 = 81965$. Isko solve karne baithega toh $T = 81965 / 0.409975$ aayega, jo exact 200000 hota hai.

Exam Takeaway: Jab ajeeb fractions aayein aur calculation fasaane wali ho, hamesha Digital Sum check kar liya kar CGL me.

StepDigital Sum Logic
Equation$T \times 2 \times 7 \times 2 = 2$
Reduction$T \times 1 = 2$

questions.q: When the price of sugar increased by $53\%$, a family reduced its consumption per month such that the expenditure on sugar was only $19\%$ more than the earlier one. If the family consumed 38.7 kg sugar per month earlier, then what is the reduction in consumption of sugar per month?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: CPR (Constant Product Ratio)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, jab bhi price aur expenditure alag-alag badhe, inverse ratio seedha hit karta hai.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Nayi consumption / Purani consumption $= (100 + E\%) / (100 + P\%) = 119 / 153$. 17 se kaat de, aayega $7/9$. Yani pehle 9 unit khate the, ab 7 unit. Kami aayi 2 unit ki. Pehle ki value 9 unit $= 38.7$ kg, toh 1 unit $= 4.3$ kg. Toh 2 unit $= 2 \times 4.3 = 8.6$ kg.

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Base 100 maan. 153 price ho gaya par pocket allow karti hai sirf 119 tak jana. Toh wapas aane ke liye $34/153$ ki kami karni padegi, yani $2/9$. $38.7$ ka $2/9$ sidha nikal le $= 8.6$ kg.

Exam Takeaway: Reverse ratio $E/P$ hamesha quantity deta hai, bas formula chat jaa.

VariableValue
New Ratio$119 / 153 = 7 / 9$
Difference$9 - 7 = 2$ units

questions.q: A bacteria culture increases by $20\%$ every hour for 3 hours, then decreases by $10\%$ in the 4th hour, and finally increases by $25\%$ in the 5th hour. If the initial count was 5,000, what will be the approximate count after 5 hours?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Successive Change (The Chain Reaction)

Pen-Free Observation: Seedha fraction denominator check kar, $125 \times 10 \times 4 = 5000$, principal se exact cut jayega. Ans decimals me nahi aayega.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Chain bana - $5000 \times (6/5)^3 \times (9/10) \times (5/4) = 5000 \times (216/125) \times (9/10) \times (5/4)$. Base cut hone pe final bacha $216 \times 9/2 \times 5...$ simply solve kar $9720$ exact value aayegi.

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Basic tree bana kar successive badha. Pehle $+20\%$, fir $+20\%$... bohot time waste hoga. Fractions rule is the only sensible way.

Exam Takeaway: Denominators ka product hamesha initial value ko set up karne ke liye diya hota hai taaki easily simplify ho sake.

RateMultiplier
$+20\%$$6/5$
$-10\%$$9/10$

questions.q: If $40\%$ of A = 0.5 of B = $\frac{1}{4}$ of C what is A:B:C? (CGL TIER I - $\frac{18}{09}$/2025 - Shift 3)
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Cross-Product Method

Pen-Free Observation: Numerator same karke denominators hi direct ratio ban jayenge, dimaag me fraction laa.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Sabko fraction me la. $40\% = 2/5$, $0.5 = 1/2$. Toh $2A/5 = B/2 = C/4$. Numerators ka LCM le (yahan 2). Sabko 2 se divide kar de: $A/5 = B/4 = C/8$. Direct denominators $5:4:8$ tumhara ratio hai.

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Isko barabar man le $k$ ke, toh A ratio B ratio C hoga $5/2 : 2 : 4$. Pura ratio 2 se multiply kar de: $5:4:8$ aayega.

Exam Takeaway: LCM method ratio equate karne me seconds bachata hai.

ValuesAdjusted
$2A/5$$A/5$
$B/2$$B/4$

questions.q: In an examination, $53\%$ students passed in Mathematics, $61\%$ passed in Physics, $60\%$ passed in Chemistry, $24\%$ passed in Mathematics and Physics, $35\%$ in Physics and Chemistry, $27\%$ in Mathematics and Chemistry and $5\%$ in none. The ratio of % of passes in Mathematics and Chemistry but not in Physics in relation to the % of passes in Physics and Chemistry but not in Mathematics is?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: JSM / Deviation (Set Theory application)

Pen-Free Observation: 3-circle Venn ka sidha overlap formula lagana hai 'All Three' nikalne ke liye.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Total pass $95\%$ honge ($5\%$ fail). $95 = 53 + 61 + 60 - 24 - 35 - 27 + All$. Solve karega toh All $= 7\%$. Only M&C (no P) $= 27 - 7 = 20\%$. Only P&C (no M) $= 35 - 7 = 28\%$. Ratio $20:28 = 5:7$.

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Venn diagram bana kar ek-ek value nikal. Pura circle set karega toh concept strong hoga par time bohot jayega.

Exam Takeaway: 'Only two' nikalte time middle 'All three' intersection subtract karna mat bhoolna.

Venn PartCalculation
All Three$7\%$
Only M&C$27 - 7 = 20\%$

questions.q: A large watermelon weighs 25 kg with $98\%$ of its weight being water. It is allowed to stand in the sun for a while and some of the water evaporates so that now only $97\%$ of it is water. What is its reduced weight?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: CPR (Base Shift / Constant Value)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, paani udta hai pulp utna hi rehta hai. Pulp ko constant kar de.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Old Pulp $= 2\%$ of $25 = 0.5$ kg. New Pulp $= 3\%$. Naya weight $= 0.5 / 0.03 = 16.66$ kg. Options check kar, sabse kareeb $16.5$ kg hai, wahi hit karna hai.

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Ratio se kar. Water:Pulp pehle $98:2$ ($49:1$), ab $97:3$. Pulp ki unit equal karne pe Naya Weight aayega.

Exam Takeaway: Dry fruit ya evaporation wale sawal mein hamesha constant solid material dhundh.

StatePulp Percentage
Initial$2\%$
Final$3\%$

questions.q: The income of A is 10,800 per month. He saves $12.5\%$ of his income. If his monthly income increases by $22.5\%$ and the expenditure increases by $30\%$, then his monthly savings decreases by
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: JSM (Junior Satisfaction Method)

Pen-Free Observation: Base values pe sidhe percentage deviation multiply kar ke net effect check karle. Original absolute value baad mein map karna.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Save $= 12.5\%$ ($1/8$). Income = 8 unit, Save = 1 unit, Exp = 7 unit. Net savings change $= (8 \times 22.5) - (7 \times 30) = 180 - 210 = -30$ units (on a 800 scale). $800u = 10800$, toh $1u = 13.5$. Drop $= 30 \times 13.5 = 405$. Absolute killer method!

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Basic values nikal (Inc=10800, Sav=1350) fir unpe percentage laga. Calculation exam mein saara time kha jayegi.

Exam Takeaway: Exact value ko hamesha last mein touch karna, pehle unit deviation nikal lo.

ParameterDeviation Unit
Income Shift$+180$
Exp Shift$+210$

questions.q: A number first increased by $8\%$ and then decreased by $3\%$ to get 2619. What is $5\%$ of that number?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Successive Change

Pen-Free Observation: 1.08 aur 2619 dono mein 9 ka multiple chhupa hai, values directly kategi.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Net change $+8 - 3 - 0.24 = 4.76\%$ up. $104.76\% = 2619$, number 2500 aayega. Iska $5\% = 2500 \times 5/100 = 125$.

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Fraction se chal $N \times (27/25) \times (97/100) = 2619$. 27 se kata 97 baar, 97 se 97 kata. Bacha 2500. $2500$ ka $5\% = 125$.

Exam Takeaway: Aise sawal me effective percentage ya fraction division dono tezi se answer dete hain, jo click kare laga de.

Math StepResult
Effective %$4.76\%$
Original No.2500

questions.q: A bag contains $20\%$ red balls, $30\%$ green balls, and the rest blue balls. If there are 80 blue balls, what is the total number of balls? (CGL TIER I - $\frac{24}{09}$/2025 - SHIFT 1)
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Bhai total $100\%$ hota hai, adhi ball de di ($50\%$), toh total value double ho jayegi.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Blue balls $= 100 - 20 - 30 = 50\%$. Agar $50\% = 80$, toh total $100\% = 160$.

Method 2 (Concept Builder): $x/2 = 80 \Rightarrow x = 160$. Basic bacho wala method hai, likhne ki zarurat nahi.

Exam Takeaway: Free ke marks mat chhodna, aise aasan sawal exam pressure test karne aate hain.

ColorPercentage

Blue$50\%$

Core Conceptual Tool: Successive Change / Options Validation

Pen-Free Observation: $18.18\%$ dekhte hi samajh jaa ki bacha hua amount 11 se katega. Reverse engineeing se try mar.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Option 30000 le. Health $= 10800$. Remaining $= 19200$. Edu hata ke bacha $= 3960$. Bacha khana hata ke $9/11 \times 3960 = 3240$. Ye Health (10800) ka $30\%$ ($10800 \times 0.3 = 3240$) hai. Match! Answer is 30000.

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Equation bana $(x \times 0.64 - 15240) \times (9/11) = 0.36x \times 0.3$. Solve karne mein pasine choot jayenge.

Exam Takeaway: Complicated beech ki values aur fractions me options test sabse fast aur safe hota hai.

questions.q: An item's price is increased by $25\%$ and then by another $20\%$. What is the overall percentage increase? (CHSL TIER I - $\frac{22}{11}$/2025 - SHIFT 2)
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Successive Change

Pen-Free Observation: $25\%$ aur $20\%$ ka successive universally $50\%$ hota hai, data directly yaad hona chahiye.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Universal formula laga: $X+Y+XY/100 = 25+20+5 = 50\%$.

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Fractions se ratio bana. $1/4$ aur $1/5$. $4 \to 5$, $5 \to 6$. Multiply kar: $20 \to 30$. Net half badha yani $50\%$.

Exam Takeaway: Standard percentages ke successive orals pe yaad hone chahiye CGL pre nikalne ke liye.

questions.q: The ratio between expenditure and saving is x:y. when income is increased by $15\%$, expenditure is increased by $20\%$ and savings are increased by $12\%$. Find the new ratio of expenditure and savings ?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: JSM / Alligation

Pen-Free Observation: Income hamesha Exp aur Sav ka combined effect hoti hai, direct Alligation thok.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Alligation: E(+20), S(+12), middle mein I(+15). Ratio of original E:S $= (15-12):(20-15) = 3:5$. Old Exp $= 300$, Sav $= 500$. New Exp $= 300$ pe $20\%$ badhakar $360$. New Sav $= 500$ pe $12\%$ badhakar $560$. Naya ratio $= 360:560 = 9:14$.

Method 2 (Concept Builder): JSM se equations banayega $20x + 12y = 15(x+y)$, toh wahi $5x = 3y \Rightarrow x/y = 3/5$ milega. Lamba method hai.

Exam Takeaway: Mixture of percentages mein aankh band karke alligation pattern lagaya kar.

EntityChange
Expenditure$+20\%$
Savings$+12\%$

questions.q: In a survey among 140 students, 60 likes to play videogames, 70 likes to play indoor games, 75 likes to play outdoor games, 30 play indoor and outdoor games, 18 like to play video games and outdoor games, 42 play video games and indoor games and 8 likes to play all types of games. Use the Venn diagram to find (i) Students who play only outdoor games (ii) Students who play video games and indoor games, but not outdoor games
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: JSM / Venn Logic

Pen-Free Observation: 'Only' nikalne ke liye outer intersections subtract karke middle wali (All-3) dobara add karni hoti hai kyunki wo 2 baar minus ho jati hai.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Only Outdoor $= 75 - 30 - 18 + 8 = 35$. Part (ii) ke liye, Video & Indoor but NOT outdoor = (V&I total) - (All 3) $= 42 - 8 = 34$. Answer 35 aur 34.

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Poora Venn diagram draw kar aur teen equation bana ke centre-out bhar. Lamba time khayega exam me.

Exam Takeaway: Specific parts nikalne ke liye pura Venn bharne ki zarurat nahi, formula set kar aur aage badh.

Required ValueFormula Result
Only Outdoor$75 - 30 - 18 + 8 = 35$
V&I no O$42 - 8 = 34$

questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Successive Change

Pen-Free Observation: Standard $+20\%$ aur $+10\%$ sidha $+32\%$ hota hai, completely verbal calculation hai.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): $20 + 10 + (20 \times 10) / 100 = 30 + 2 = 32\%$. Sidha tick mark maar.

Method 2 (Concept Builder): $100 \to 120 \to 132$, farak $32\%$.

Exam Takeaway: Lallu sawalo par 10 sec se zyada diya toh agla mushkil question chhut jayega.

questions.q: The rate of income tax increases from $15.2\%$ to $20.9\%$. due to this Gaurav had to pay $5.55\%$ more tax than previous year. but simultaneously income of Gaurav also decreases by $18400 \text{ Rs.}$ find income of Gaurav last year?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: CPR (Income $\times$ Rate = Tax)

Pen-Free Observation: Decimals ko bhool ja, 152 aur 209 seedha 19 ki table me aate hain. Ratio ready hai!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Tax ratio $= 19/18$ ($5.55\%$ inc). Rate ratio $= 209/152 = 11/8$. Income ratio $= (19/11) / (18/8) = 76/99$. Income ghati 23 unit se. $23u = 18400 \Rightarrow 1u = 800$. Last year Income $= 99 \times 800 = 79200$.

Method 2 (Concept Builder): $I_1 \times 0.152 = T_1$, $I_2 \times 0.209 = T_2$. Pura equation bana kar cross multiply kar, calculations me fas jayega.

Exam Takeaway: Ratios aur unke multipliers decimal equations se khelna aasan kar mitigates karte hain.

MetricRatio (New/Old)
Rate$11 / 8$
Income$76 / 99$

questions.q: If the height of a triangle is increased by $20\%$ and the base is increased by $12\%$, what is the new area if the old area was 200 cm$^2$?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Successive Change

Pen-Free Observation: Area multiplier $1.2 \times 1.12$ hoga, direct multiplication hi fast rahega.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Area multiplier $= 1.2 \times 1.12 = 1.344$. $200 \times 1.344 = 268.8$. Seedha aur sateek.

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Pehle net percentage nikal le: $20 + 12 + 2.4 = 34.4\%$. 200 ka $34.4\%$ hota hai $68.8$. Add kiya toh $268.8$.

Exam Takeaway: Jab initial value given ho aur rate easy fractions me na ho, toh decimal multiplier lagana best hota hai.

ComponentMultiplier
Height1.2

questions.q: If B is $25\%$ more than A, and C is $20\%$ more than B, then what is A: C? (CGL TIER I - $\frac{13}{09}$/2025 - SHIFT 3)
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Successive Change / Ratio Shift

Pen-Free Observation: Sidha fraction lagao. $5/4$ aur $6/5$ ki chain ban rahi hai.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): $A/B = 4/5$, $B/C = 5/6$. Dono multiply kiye, $A/C = 4/6 = 2/3$. Ratio 2:3 ho gaya.

Method 2 (Concept Builder): A=100 le le. B=125. C=$125 + 25 = 150$. $A:C = 100:150 = 2:3$.

Exam Takeaway: Chain wali ratios seedha series multiplication se udayi jati hain.

questions.q: A contractor estimated that a project would cost $\text{Rs. } 5$,00,000. He planned for $60\%$ of the cost to go to materials, $25\%$ to labor, and the rest as contingency. However, due to delays, material cost increased by $12.5\%$, labor cost increased by $10\%$, and contingency remained unchanged. What is the new total cost? (CHSL TIER I - $\frac{30}{11}$/2025 - SHIFT 1)
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: JSM / Deviation

Pen-Free Observation: Original 5 Lakh ko tod mat, seedha un percentages ka deviation effect nikal ke jod de.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Material $60\%$ pe $12.5\%$ change $= 7.5\%$ effect. Labour $25\%$ pe $10\%$ change $= 2.5\%$ effect. Net change $= +10\%$. 5 Lakh ka $10\%$ ($50,000$) badha de $= 5,50,000$.

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Har part ko rupees me calculate kar: Material 3L, Labor 1.25L. Phir unpe individually percent badha ke jodd. Bahut lamba calculation padega.

Exam Takeaway: Over-all change sum of base deviations se jaldi nikalta hai, absolute figures end me dekhi jati hain.

Cost ComponentDeviation Impact
Material$60\% \times 12.5\% = +7.5\%$
Labour$25\% \times 10\% = +2.5\%$

questions.q: The price of a radio at the beginning of an year was $\text{Rs. } 3000$. It increased by x% and then decreased by y% over the year. It increased by x% and then decreased by y% over the next year too. At the end of the second year, the price of the radio was $\text{Rs. } 3000$. Which of the following can be concluded?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Successive Change

Pen-Free Observation: Agar kisi value ko up karke aur dusri baar down karke wapas wahi bache, toh mathematically up wala fraction hamesha bada hota hai.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Algebraically formula laga: $(1+x/100)(1-y/100) = 1 \Rightarrow x-y = xy/100$. RHS ek positive fraction hai, matlab $x - y$ positive hona chahiye. Iska seedha matlab hai $x > y$.

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Dummy values daal kar check kar. Agar $100$ ko $25\%$ badhaya toh $125$ hua. Wapas $100$ aane ke liye $20\%$ ghatana padega. Matlab increase ka percent ($25\%$) bada hoga decrease se ($20\%$).

Exam Takeaway: Conceptually strong raho, bina pen uthaye aise dummy variables wale sawal solve hote hain.

Math RuleConclusion
$x - y = \text{Positive}$$x > y$

questions.q: $5\%$ of a = b, then b% of 20 is the same as
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Variables dekhke ghabrana nahi hai, seedhi equation balance karni aani chahiye.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Diya hai $b = 0.05a$. Pucha hai $b\%$ of $20$, matlab $20b/100 = b/5$. Replace $b$ with $0.05a$, aayega $0.01a$. Options me dekho, $20\%$ of $a/20 = 0.2 \times (a/20) = 0.01a$ hai. Exact match!

Method 2 (Concept Builder): $a$ ko 100 maan le, toh $b = 5$. Pucha hai $5\%$ of $20 = 1$. Options check kar jisme $a=100$ rakhne pe 1 aaye. Option (c) $20\%$ of $100/20 = 1$. Hit ho gaya!

Exam Takeaway: Variables jab pareshan karein toh base value 100 assume karke option testing kar leni chahiye.

MethodResult
Equation$b/5 = 0.01a$

questions.q: When the price of rice is increased by 25 percent, a family reduces its consumption such that the expenditure is only 10 percent more than before. If 40 kg of rice is consumed by family before, then find the new consumption of family.
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: CPR (Constant Product Ratio)

Pen-Free Observation: Expenditure pura constant nahi hai, base shift wale ratio me formula adjust karna padega.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Naya Consumption / Purana Consumption $= (100+10)/(100+25) = 110/125 = 22/25$. Purana 25 unit $= 40$ kg, matlab 1 unit $= 1.6$. Naya 22 unit $= 22 \times 1.6 = 35.2$ kg.

Method 2 (Concept Builder): $P \times C = E$ likhkar initial $100 \times 100 = 10000$ aur final $125 \times C = 11000$ karega toh bhi $C = 88$ aayega. Ratio phir bhi $100:88$ yani $25:22$ banega.

Exam Takeaway: $C_2/C_1 = (100 \pm E\%) / (100 \pm P\%)$ is chapter ka sabse bada hack hai, tips pe hona chahiye.

Formula PatternRatio Produced
$(100+E)/(100+P)$$22/25$

questions.q: Two persons A and B contested in an election and $20\%$ of the votes were invalid. A got $40\%$ and $45\%$ of invalid and valid votes respectively. If B won by 480 votes, then find the total votes got by B?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Dhyaan se padh, valid/invalid dono me ratio bante hue chalega. Ye examiner ka trap hai.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Total $100x$. Invalid $20x$, Valid $80x$. A ko mila $40\%$ of invalid ($8x$) and $45\%$ of valid ($36x$). B ko bache hue milenge: Valid me se $55\%$ ($44x$) aur Invalid me se $60\%$ ($12x$). Haar jeet sirf Valid me count hoti hai. Valid diff B-A $= 44x - 36x = 8x$. $8x = 480 \Rightarrow x = 60$. Total B votes $= (12+44)x = 56 \times 60 = 3360$.

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Tree diagram bana le exam mein taaki galtiya na ho, but mind me har stream clear rakhni padegi.

Exam Takeaway: Examiner wordplay karke fasaata hai. 'Invalid me se hissa' line achhe se scan kiya kar aise mains-level sawalo me.

Vote TypeA's ShareB's Share
Valid (80x)$36x$$44x$
Invalid (20x)$8x$$12x$

questions.q: A jar is $\frac{3}{5}$ full with a solution. After adding 3.2 liters, it becomes $\frac{7}{8}$ full. What is the total capacity of the jar? (CPO TIER I- $\frac{10}{12}$/2025 - SHIFT 2)
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Fraction fraction khelna hai bas, base same kar LCM leke.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Sidha fraction difference le: $7/8 - 3/5 = 11/40$. Yani jar ka $11/40$ part $= 3.2$ L. Total $= (3.2 \times 40)/11 = 128/11 = 11.6363...$ L. Options me $11.64$ clear match hai.

Method 2 (Concept Builder): LCM 40 maan le. Pehle 24 litre bhara tha, ab 35 litre bhara. Fark aaya 11 unit ka jo 3.2 L ke barabar hai. Total 40 unit nikalne ke liye Unitary method laga.

Exam Takeaway: Fractions ke questions me hamesha denominators ka LCM assume karke kaam aasan hota hai.

StateFraction Part
Difference$11/40$
Value Match$11/40 = 3.2 \text{ L}$

questions.q: The price of an article increased by $15\%$ every year. If the difference between the price at the end of third and fourth year is 138 then $65\%$ of the price at the end of second year?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Successive Change

Pen-Free Observation: Reverse me interest wale concept ki tarah soch. 4th aur 3rd saal ka difference matlab seedha 3rd saal ke price pe laga $15\%$ increment.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): $15\%$ of $P_3 = 138 \Rightarrow P_3 = 920$. Ab $P_2$ me $15\%$ jud kar $920$ bana, yani $115\%$ of $P_2 = 920 \Rightarrow P_2 = 800$. Iska $65\%$ nikalna hai: $800 \times 0.65 = 520$.

Method 2 (Concept Builder): 100 maan kar karega toh decimals jayega ($100 \to 115 \to 132.25$). Time zyada lagega aise CI structures me.

Exam Takeaway: Consecutive years ka difference seedha pichle saal ke interest ya rate of increment ke barabar hota hai CI wale logic me.

Stage MappingValue
$P_3$ Value$138 / 0.15 = 920$
$P_2$ Value$920 / 1.15 = 800$

questions.q: 2/5th of the voters promise to vote for A and the rest promised to vote for B. Of these, on the last day $15\%$ of the voters went back of their promise to vote for A and $25\%$ of voters went back of their promise to vote for B, and A lost by 200 votes. Then, the total number of voters is?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Decimal na aaye isliye ek heavy base $1000x$ lele aur swap ki matrix chala de.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): A ko 400x, B ko 600x promise the. A ke $15\%$ ($60x$) B ko mile. B ke $25\%$ ($150x$) A ko mile. Final A $= 400 - 60 + 150 = 490x$. Final B $= 600 - 150 + 60 = 510x$. Haar/Jeet diff $= 20x$. Diya hai $20x = 200 \Rightarrow x=10$. Total votes $= 1000x = 10000$.

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Shift matrix directly likh: $+150-60 = +90$ net shift A ke favour me. Naya A $= 400+90 = 490$. Diff nikal lo.

Exam Takeaway: Values assume karte time zeros ka bharpoor istemal karo taaki fractions aur decimals ke jaal me na faso.

CandidateFinal Tally
A$490x$
B$510x$
